role: The shaped recipe: a width*height ingredient grid matched at every offset of the crafting grid, optionally mirrored, with wildcard damage 32767 accepted for any damage.
scope_reason: Most of the 317 recipes are shaped; the wooden-pickaxe loop (SPEC milestone 5) needs matching, mirroring and getRecipeSize.

members.name: ShapedRecipes
members.note: Constructor state is flattened into the generated struct recipe_def (kind, mirrored, width, height, size, items, count, output).

members.name: recipeItems
members.note: Ingredient stacks live in the flat RECIPE_ITEMS table; a recipe owns a run from items to items+count.

members.name: field_92101_f
members.note: The struct's mirrored flag. Only CraftingManager's carrot-on-a-stick recipe sets it, and fishing is switched off (world.conf fishing = off), so the tag-copy branch never fires in this game.

members.name: getRecipeOutput
members.note: A field read; the native caller reads recipe_def.output directly.

members.name: matches
members.note: Every offset the recipe fits at, mirror tried first at each offset; the scan stays over 3x3 even on the player's 2x2 grid, where the third row and column read null.

members.name: checkMatch
members.note: Item identity and, unless the ingredient's damage is the 32767 wildcard, damage are compared; no NBT comparison.

members.name: getCraftingResult
members.note: A copy of the output; when the mirrored flag is set, the tag of the last tagged grid stack rides along.

members.name: func_92100_c
members.note: Sets the mirrored flag at registration; the generated recipe_def carries it.

notes: test_crafting.c replays 20,000 random probe grids plus special cases including a mirrored recipe over a tagged stack. The World argument is unused by vanilla here; the native matcher takes no world.
